description: This Java class configures OpenAPI documentation and global CORS settings for a Spring Boot application. It defines the OpenAPI server URLs to include a relative path and a specific preview environment, ensuring proper Swagger UI functionality across environments. Additionally, it sets up permissive CORS policies to facilitate development and testing.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up OpenAPI documentation and global CORS policies for the application.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and configures the OpenAPI object with server URLs, API info, and version.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Provides a WebMvcConfigurer bean that configures CORS to allow all origins and methods for development.
